bias.zh: 看空 · 再度跌破 200 日均线，受制于 $398–401

read.en: TSMC fell 2.2% on Nov 4 to $395.75, trading between $391.61 and $410.59. It is below the falling 5-day ($407.4), 10-day ($416.9), 30-day ($438.4) and 100-day ($429.1) averages and slipped back under the rising 200-day ($401.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($436.79), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 台积电 11月4日下跌 2.2%，收于 $395.75，盘中区间 $391.61–410.59。股价位于下行的 5 日（$407.4）、10 日（$416.9）、30 日（$438.4）和 100 日均线（$429.1）下方，并再度跌回上行的 200 日均线（$401.1）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$436.79），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $410.6 high failed at the $405–411 resistance and the close lost the $398.3–401.1 support (200-day, Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $398.3–401.1, then $405.2–410.6 (5-day, June and August lows, Nov 4 high) and $416.9–420. Support is $386–388.8 (July lows), then $381.3 and $372.7. A close above $401.1 would target $405–411; below $386, $381.

r.en: 200-day average $401.1; Oct 30 low $400.1; Nov 2 low $398.3, lost
5-day average $407.4; Jun 9 and Aug 24 lows ($405.2–405.5); Nov 4 high $410.6
